benchmarks.note: Land benchmarks: average transacted ¥/tsubo by station, 2023–2025, Utinokati (MLIT transaction data). Kawagoe market context: used houses transacted at about ¥96–98万/tsubo in 2025–26; new houses in this city typically ask ¥3,400–4,100万 (goo listing averages). Official land prices rose +1% to +5% across Kawagoe districts in 2026. Tsurugashima (added Oct 2026 for the Shimohiroya section): station-area transactions average about ¥28万/tsubo; Shimohiroya's own plots sit 19–27 minutes out in an urbanisation-control area, which the walk band and the cautions carry.

shimohiroya.note: Added 24 Oct 2026 at a reader's request. Shimohiroya (大字下広谷) is a district on Kawagoe's western edge whose nearest station is Tsurugashima, across the city border — so this section deliberately breaks the edition's 15-minute rule: walks here run 13–33 minutes, and the walk still costs score exactly as it does everywhere else. Much of the district is urbanisation-control area (市街化調整区域), where building and rebuilding need permission; each card's cautions carry that, with score penalties where it bites. The usual ¥5,000万 cap still applies — the one Shimohiroya plot above it (3,931m² at ¥10,000万) is excluded. Same score maths, same benchmarks, nothing hidden.
shimohiroya.noteJa: 2026年10月24日、リクエストを受けて追加したセクションです。下広谷（大字下広谷）は川越市西端の地区で、最寄り駅は市境の向こうの鶴ヶ島駅です。そのためこのセクションでは本編の「徒歩15分以内」ルールをあえて外しています（徒歩13〜33分。徒歩時間は他と同じ計算でスコアに反映されます）。地区の多くは市街化調整区域で、建築・再建築には許可が必要です — 各カードの注意点に、効くところでは減点付きで明示しています。価格上限は通常どおり5,000万円（下広谷で唯一それを超える3,931m²・1億円の土地は収録していません）。スコア計算とベンチマークは本編と同一です。
